answer: Give every agent a kernel of verifiable history: before joining the market, an agent must complete a small set of paid, checkable tasks under one identity, and that record is hashed into a single kernel peers can audit. A newcomer with no history is dimmed to an umber shade, visible but untrusted and limited to tiny trades until the record grows. Honest agents carry a lantern of past good work others can see, while a sybil farmer must pay the full cost of building a real history for each fake identity, making mass fakery unprofitable.
